title: Balanced brackets of three kinds
prompt: The input encodes a bracket string: 1, 2, 3 are the openers '(', '[', '{' and -1, -2, -3 are the matching closers ')', ']', '}' (no other values appear). Return true if the string is balanced: every closer matches the most recent still-unmatched opener of the same kind, and no opener is left unmatched at the end. The empty list is balanced.
